_readme: Overrides for the Flow DOM. Anything set here wins over the built-in defaults.
When a run starts failing because Flow changed its UI, this is the file to edit -
no code change and no restart of the tool beyond the next run.
Leave a key out to keep the built-in value. Delete this file to go back to defaults.
Run `node show_config.js` to print the values currently in effect and where each came from.
